text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after Chairwoman Akikawa took 
off, right around the time I sent <chrname> out to 
run the perimeter—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I noticed an unfamiliar woman watching the 
Umamusume during their training.

...You... You're the Trainer of the girl 
who just went out to the perimeter, aren't 
you?

"I had the pleasure of watching your 
training. Pardon my bluntness right upon 
meeting, but..."
—Tepid.

Allowing voluntary training, lacking 
strict start times, permitting idle 
chatter with other Umamusume during 
breaks...
Oh, that look says you're not convinced.

Then what about her sleep duration and 
daily sleep satisfaction? Do you interview 
her every single day without fail?

Lack of sleep not only degrades 
performance, but also invites accidents. 
Keeping track of it is a matter of course.

"...I am well aware, of course, that this 
academy places great value on student 
autonomy."

However, that guiding principle is 
itself—irresponsible.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that, the woman quietly cast her gaze 
toward the distant mountains.

—That cedar mountain you see in the 
distance is a popular spot that's bustling 
with climbers in season.

Splendid cedar trees rustle softly, little 
birds chirp, and the soft, rich soil 
gently cushions our feet.

"However, much like many mountains in this 
country, its shape exists only because of 
human hands."

Unmanaged mountains fall into ruin. 
Sunlight never reaches the ground, the 
grass withers, and underfoot is nothing 
but accumulated humus and dead, fallen 
trees.

It could also lead to landslides and 
flooding. That is precisely what 
"management" entails.

Just watching an immature girl fall into 
ruin is nothing more than the ego of an 
adult trying to seem kind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The woman's eyes gradually grew sharper as 
she spoke. Just as tension filled the air—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"So this is where you were! I've been 
looking for you, Acting Director 
Kashimoto!"

Excuse me, I was just curious about your 
training scene.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! Perfect timing. This person 
here is representing Chairwoman Akikawa—

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"I am Riko Kashimoto. I have been 
entrusted with full authority over the 
academy's policies during my term."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Here you go... I'll be in your care.
